Deck v2 · visual direction · for sign-off before the pptx is rebuilt
The new direction

Make the deck behave like the product.

Same slides, same words. The difference is that every slide now works the way the Praxis HUD works: it tells you where you are, lights up the one thing that matters, and keeps everything else quiet. The pitch looks like the product it's selling.

Why the current deck falls flat
Every slide has the same weight. Gray ground, mid-size type, and empty space that isn't doing anything.
Nothing tells the eye where to go first. The orange is there, but it's too small to lead.
It switches personality. The photo slides feel like the product. The text slides feel like a document.
Five rules for v2
01

The deck coaches the room. Every slide carries the HUD: the progress pill shows where we are in the pitch, and the chip holds the one line to remember.

02

One thing lit. The spotlight from the HUD mocks, used everywhere: one word, number or box at full brightness, the rest dimmed.

03

Extreme scale. Hero numbers at 150–200 pt against 9 pt mono labels. Nothing in between.

04

The belief bars. The tracker's step-probability bars become the deck's graphic, the way the dot is the logo's.

05

Dark for the story, aluminum for the proof. Problem, product and how-it-works are dark. Numbers get light "spec sheet" slides.
